designationHistory.indexText: Wapato Lake, first acquired from 2008 as a unit of Tualatin River National Wildlife Refuge, was established as its own national wildlife refuge in 2013.

authority.citation: Fish and Wildlife Service administrative action

designationHistory.note: Pass A (fws.gov: officially established in 2013 as part of the Tualatin River NWR Complex) and Pass B (Oregon Encyclopedia: named Wapato Lake National Wildlife Refuge in 2013; OPB: established in 2013) agree on the year. No exact date or establishing document was found. Public access opened February 1, 2023.

sources.name: OPB, Think Out Loud, "Wapato Lake wildlife refuge" (Apr. 4, 2023)
